newsitem.title: JAPAN: Top Nomura officials resign from Keidanren posts.
newsitem.headline: Top Nomura officials resign from Keidanren posts.

text.p: The chairman and president of Nomura Securities Co Ltd have both resigned from their senior positions at Japan's powerful business lobby, the Japan Federation of Economic Organisations (Keidanren), Keidanren chairman Shoichiro Toyoda said on Monday.
Toyoda said he had accepted the resignations of Nomura chairman Masashi Suzuki and president Hideo Sakamaki.
Nomura's recent admission that two of its directors were involved in irregular dealings with a corporate client could result in stiff penalties for the nation's biggest securities firm.

"President Sakamaki said that he was responsible for what the Nomura directors had done since he is at the top of the management," Toyoda told a regular news conference, adding that the resignations took effect on Monday.
